verdict.rationale: Sardine documents an API reference, SDKs and sample apps, though they sit behind protected, access-gated documentation. A sandbox account is also available for trying calls. Nothing shows the reference is interactive (e.g., try-it consoles) or embeds runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples within the reference, publicly accessible reference docs, and hands-on corroboration.
